records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Product revenue accounted for 46% and 51% of our consolidated revenue for the three and six months ended June 30, 2023, as compared to 44% and 46% for the three and six months ended June 30, 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The Company’s continued execution delivered strong results during the second quarter of 2023, driven by continued demand in our memory interface chips and our Silicon IP solutions, and continued stability from our royalties revenue.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Changes in operating assets and liabilities for the six months ended June 30, 2023 primarily included a decrease in unbilled receivables and an increase in other current liabilities, offset by increases in inventories and accounts receivable, as well as decreases in accounts payable, deferred revenue and income taxes payable.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cost of product revenue for the three months ended June 30, 2023, decreased approximately $1.7 million as compared to the same period in 2022, primarily due to a change in product mix.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cash provided by operating activities of $89.3 million for the six months ended June 30, 2023, was primarily attributable to the cash generated from customer licensing, product sales and engineering services fees.
